description: Ask to tour a rental on A-du, as the signed-in person. Sends the landlord up to three preferred times and an optional note. The landlord accepts or declines; this does not book anything. Returns the message and thread so the conversation can be followed up.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying so a dropped response cannot create a second request.

listing_id.description: The rental to tour, from search_rentals.

preferred_times.description: One to three preferred times, each as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the listing's local time.

name: request_tour
title: Request a tour
